query: SELECT work.workspace_id, work.delivery_state, work.watermark_created_at, work.watermark_run_id, COALESCE(work.cursor_created_at, work.watermark_created_at) AS "cursor_created_at!", work.cursor_run_id FROM central.recovery_epoch_workspaces AS work JOIN central.recovery_epochs AS epoch ON epoch.epoch_generation = work.epoch_generation AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $3 WHERE work.epoch_generation = $1 AND work.delivery_state = 'pending' AND (work.retry_not_before IS NULL OR work.retry_not_before <= clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY work.workspace_id LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE OF work SKIP LOCKED
